name: RommPS
description: Syncs your emulator saves and states with a RomM server and downloads games from your RomM library.
author: s0liton
release_notes:
Update RommPS and open it once. It takes care of the rest.

Fixed
- The extra "RomM Sync" icon is gone.
- RomM Sync now starts with onionHEN too.
- Old copies of RomM Sync no longer start or replace newer ones.
- RommPS shows the right time for the last sync.
- Saving settings in the web UI no longer undoes changes made in RommPS.
- The library picks up emulator changes right away, without restarting RommPS.

Added
- RomM Sync starts with the console by default.
- New home screen art.

Changed
- RomM Sync updates come with RommPS.
- No more RomM Sync notifications while RommPS is installed, except sync results.
